summary: FND-04 failure and observability baseline: correlation middleware with x-request-id UUID propagation, Server-Timing duration tracking, 1 MiB body limit, 5000ms deadline timeout, central error handler with safe 500 masking preventing database/credential leaks, and canonical error envelope mapping for all standard API v0.3 status codes. Strict typecheck passed; wrangler dry-run build passed; 20/20 observability tests passed; full suite of 74 tests passed.
api_contract: docs/API.md v0.3 (Common rules, standard error envelope { error: { code, message, requestId, details? } }, 400-504 code mappings, and no-store caching).
limitations: Application-level timeouts and body limits are enforced in Hono middleware; external reverse proxies and Cloudflare edge limits provide additional perimeter boundaries.
Distributed rate limiting counters (e.g. KV / memory store) are deferred until multi-instance deployments; 429 status mapping and Retry-After: 60 headers are verified.

evidence.command: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false node --test apps/api/test/observability.test.ts && npm run check
evidence.result: Observability suite passed 20 tests across 9 suites in ~250ms. Full repository check passed with 0 TypeScript errors, 866.63 KiB dry-run worker build, and 74 total passing tests (33 api + 41 contracts).
evidence.environment: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Node 24.15.0, npm 11.12.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, Hono 4.13.14, Wrangler 4.152.0.

next_dependency_ready_task: INV-02 and NTF-03 can now consume the correlation ID, safe error handler, and deadline baseline.
